The U.S. has reportedly asked Gulf Arab countries to prepare for a 'short and intense' military operation against Iran. President Donald Trump has said that 'anything is possible' after the midterm elections slated for November 3. What options does Trump have? How will Iran respond? Palki Sharma tells you.
